messages.content: 如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？

function.name: calculate_maximum_height
function.description: Calculate the maximum height an object will reach if it's thrown straight upwards with an initial velocity, ignoring air resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity in meters per second. This is a float type value.

gravity.description: The acceleration due to gravity in meters per second squared, default value is 9.8. This is a float type value.

message.content:
在地球表面，忽略空氣阻力的情況下，物體的加速度（重力加速度）是常數，約為 \(9.8 \text{ m/s}^2\)，方向向下。  
因此，無論你以多快的初速度把球往上拋，球在上升過程中會受到約 \(-9.8 \text{ m/s}^2\) 的加速度（負號表示方向與初速度相反）。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？" They want the acceleration? Actually they ask: "What acceleration will it reach?" But acceleration is constant due to gravity: -9.8 m/s^2 downward. They might be confused. They might want maximum height. But the question: "它將達到什麼加速度？" Means "What acceleration will it reach?" The answer: acceleration due to gravity is constant, about -9.8 m/s^2 downward. So the ball will accelerate downward at 9.8 m/s^2. So we can answer that. No function call needed.
